Hello Abel and team,

I am writing about my order #Shop····, placed October 19, 2026: one
BSB Bitaxe Gamma 602 (1.8 TH/s), total US$46.99, shipping to
(address hidden).

The order confirmation said I would receive a separate email with DHL
tracking the moment the order leaves the warehouse. Nine days later I
have not received any tracking email, and I would like to confirm the
order is on its way.

Could you please tell me:
1. Has the order shipped yet?
2. If yes, what is the DHL tracking number?
3. If not, when is it expected to ship?

Thank you,
Romi M.
Note to the team: I'll look up the order first.
Handed to the team · No restock or ship date exists for the bsbgamma line, and the order is past its

Hi Romi,

Thanks for writing, and I'm sorry you've had to ask. Your order has not shipped yet, so there is no tracking number, and we should have told you that instead of leaving you waiting nine days. That silence is on us.

Here is where it actually stands. Your Bitaxe Gamma 602 was sold as in stock with a two business day handling time, but the warehouse serving Canada is out of stock on that unit, so your parcel is sitting there waiting on the next units to arrive. Your order is paid in full and still fully allocated, nothing has been cancelled or changed, and the Harlo OS Diagnostics plus 3-Month RMA goes with it.

What I cannot give you honestly is a new ship date, because there isn't a confirmed restock date on the Gamma 602 yet. Rather than guess, I've put this in front of the team to get the real date from the warehouse. They pick it up today at 10am Eastern and the answer comes straight back to you in this thread.

The tracking email still works the way the confirmation described: the moment the label is printed, the carrier tracking is emailed to this address automatically. Our mail has been landing in junk for some customers, so it is worth adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts so it reaches you.

Sorry again for the wait and the silence, Romi.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
